g.text: cmd: just retrieval-up | pass: prints '<file> ... sha256 verified' for both models; a hash mismatch exits 1 and installs nothing
cmd: just model-guard .models/FILE | pass: line starts PASS, exit 0 (a FAIL or ERROR stops retrieval-up before any container starts)
cmd: just retrieval-up | pass: prints 'retrieval-up: both servers healthy' (both /health return 200 within 40 s)
cmd: just retrieval-status | pass: both lines read 'http 200'
cmd: just gateway-up, then POST 127.0.0.1:4000/v1/embeddings | pass: HTTP 200 and a vector of 768 numbers, identical on repeat
cmd: just retrieval-down | pass: podman ps -a lists neither container and ports 8081 and 8082 are free
